notes:
Reached via Chrome connector directly (Shopify store, no WAF/challenge encountered; robots.txt carries no Claude-specific disallow, only standard admin/cart/checkout disallows, Sitemap: /sitemap.xml). Tree source: the live mega-menu 'Furniture' department (children: Dining Room & Kitchen Furniture, Seating, Living Room, Tables, Furniture Accessories) plus each landing page's own sub-category chip strip (walked one level deeper into each), plus the Junior department page for Junior Bedroom Furniture, plus a scan of the full /collections.json roster (374 collections) for furniture keywords to catch anything the nav under-reports (brief trap #1). Counts are the rendered 'N items' header on each collection page, cross-checked by exhaustion-paging /collections/<handle>/products.json (limit=250) to a unique product-ID count -- the two always agreed, so header counts are reported as-is. Sanity check: children summed to the parent's own displayed total exactly for every branch (Dining Room & Kitchen Furniture 28+38+2+12+2=82; Living Room's raw 6 chips summed to 96; Tables' raw 4 chips summed to 50) -- verifying the counting method before applying the dedup below.

MAJOR SITE QUIRK -- duplicate collections under different handles/nav paths, confirmed via ID-for-ID product list comparison (not just count-matching): the site links the SAME underlying collection under two or three different handles from different rooms/product-type nav paths. Confirmed identical product-ID sets: dining-and-kitchen-chairs == dining-chairs (28); modern-bar-and-counter-stools == bar-and-counter-stools (38); dining-tables-and-kitchen-tables == dining-tables-kitchen-tables-1 (2); buffet-tables-and-sideboards == buffet-tables-and-credenzas (12); entryway-and-console-tables == entryway-console-tables-1 (2); and coffee-tables-and-side-tables (Living Room chip, 43) == exact union of side-tables (27) + coffee-tables (16) under the Tables branch. Given this, the 'Seating' branch (Dining Chairs + Bar & Counter Stools, page total 75) is ENTIRELY redundant with Dining Room & Kitchen Furniture's two chips plus Living Room's Accent Chairs (28+38+9=75 exactly) -- Seating is omitted as a grouping row per the no-duplicate-row rule (its two children are the same products as Dining & Kitchen Chairs / Modern Bar & Counter Stools, canonicalized there instead). Likewise Living Room's own 'Coffee Tables & Side Tables', 'Entryway & Console Tables' and 'Buffet Tables & Credenzas' chips are omitted (duplicates of Tables/Dining-branch nodes, canonicalized there); Living Room keeps only its non-duplicate children: Accent Chairs, Ottomans & Benches, Sofas. Tables branch keeps Side Tables, Coffee Tables, Consoles; its 'Dining Tables & Kitchen Tables' chip (dining-tables-kitchen-tables-1) is omitted as the confirmed duplicate of the Dining-branch node of the same name.

EXCLUDED (checked, not extracted): 'Furniture Accessories' (/collections/furniture-accessories, 5 items) -- all felt floor protectors, i.e. furniture care/parts, excluded per brief. 'Bathroom Furniture' (/collections/bathroom-furniture, 9 items, live but not linked from current nav) -- inspected product-by-product: 8 of 9 are towel holders/racks and toilet-paper holders (bathroom fixtures/accessories), only 1 borderline stool; not extracted as the collection is not furniture despite its name. '/collections/outdoor-furniture' -- bad slug, silently serves the Bathroom Furniture page instead of 404ing (brief trap #2); no live Outdoor Furniture department exists in current nav or sitemap, and no dedicated outdoor collection was found elsewhere. 'Bookshelves & Shelf Units' (/collections/bookshelves-and-shelf-units) -- loads (not a 404) but has 0 products and is not linked from any current nav path; not emitted per the 'no listing page worth recording' guidance combined with zero content. 'Junior Decorative Accessories', 'Junior Wall Decor & Mirrors', 'Junior Lighting', 'Junior Throw Pillows' -- out of scope for furniture (decor/lighting task). 'Baby' collection (35 SKUs, full title list inspected) -- zero furniture items; all rugs, lamps, wall decor, throws, hampers, mirrors -- no crib/dresser/changing-table type SKUs found, so no Baby furniture row. Rooted Table / Tiny Toadstools / Table of the Land / Taupe Furniture / Walnut Furniture / Smart Styles chairs -- all marketing capsule collections or colour/material filter buckets per brief section 3, not extracted. All *Sale/Clearance/OBP/Prime Picks/Unbeatable-deals/View-All/Newest-Furniture collections in the 374-collection roster were excluded as marketing junk per brief section 3.
